meta.title: LUT ARCHIVE UX / performance audit — raw measurements

target.localSnapshot: git HEAD 10935f1 (public/ extracted with git archive; deployed HTML hashes match this commit exactly)
target.localServer: http://127.0.0.1:8799 (Node static server mimicking HEAD worker headers: HTML max-age=300; other assets max-age=0 must-revalidate + ETag; gzip for text; /api/geo -> {"country":"CN"})

meta.browser: Google Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.18, headless=true, ANGLE Metal on Apple M4 (WebGL2 hardware, not SwiftShader)
meta.networkNote: Host network path to Cloudflare is erratic. Chrome had to be launched with --no-proxy-server: the machine system proxy (127.0.0.1:7897) resets connections to this host (net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED after ~11.5 s in 100% of 6 attempts), while direct curl/browser requests succeed. All production numbers are direct-path.
meta.harnessCaveat: Headless Chromium rAF cadence here is 30 Hz (idle p50 33.4 ms, measured), not 60 Hz; frame/dropped counts are relative to that baseline and Playwright CDP overhead is included in "paint" latencies. Event Timing durations (click -> next paint) are not inflated by the harness.

interactionsCpu4.note: smoke run; collected while another browser session was active => baseline contaminated, treat magnitudes as upper bounds

interactionsCpu1.note: fast pass, CPU 1, n=3 per action

productionHttp.note: curl, direct, Accept-Encoding: gzip, sequential samples; TTFB/throughput observed to vary by >50x within minutes (erratic throttling).

/luts.bin.gz.note: 2 of 4 samples timed out with 368-598 KB of 1.34 MB received

/favicon.ico.note: app page declares no <link rel=icon>; Chrome requests /favicon.ico and 404s

productionHttp.deploymentNote: Deployed HEAD 10935f1 serves the ASSETS-layer default cache-control (max-age=0, must-revalidate) for every non-HTML asset, including the 1.34 MB LUT pack, photos and the 1.2 MB decoder WASM. The working tree (uncommitted, not live at audit time) has cacheControlFor()/LONG_LIVED in src/worker.js; the Lead reports content-hashed immutable caching shipped today => revalidation finding is historical.

productionBrowserProbe.note: n=1 full navigation that completed to the 120 s app-ready cap (direct path, desktop 1440x900 DPR2). This is the only production load observation that produced a navigation timing; 5 earlier production runs also hit the cap and were discarded when the matrix was killed for time. Treat as a single-sample observation, not a distribution.
